verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a first-party Webhook integration: its servers send outbound webhook requests carrying a Honeybadger-Token header, and a new bearer-token field lets programmatic consumers such as Cursor Automations receive them. Integrations also let users choose which error events trigger a notification. missing for 10: webhook payload schema and event-type documentation, delivery/retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Our Webhook integration has a new bearer token field. Now, users can integrate Honeybadger with platforms like Cursor Automations.
Requests sent from Honeybadger servers for source maps, web hooks, and uptime checks include the header Honeybadger-Token
You get to choose which error events result in a notification or ticket being created
